name: TFF v2 - HYPOTHETICAL truly flying fish
body_plan_statement: The body plan is the flying fish's, with the spec's wing area, span and flight-muscle fraction applied. Nothing here is anatomy: no such animal has been described, dissected or measured. EVERY piece is hypothetical.

pectoral_span_over_SL.reason: TFF span 0.66442 m (= sqrt(9 * W / 12), physics/flier/design.py) over the real fish's measured 0.261 m (Park & Choi L3). Body SL unchanged, so the span RATIO carries the whole change.

pectoral_area_over_SL2.reason: lifting area 0.04905 m2 at wing loading 12 N/m2 over the real reference area 0.012688 m2. The multiplier is applied to EVERY lifting surface (pectoral, pelvic, caudal) so the TOTAL lifting area hits the spec and the surfaces keep their measured proportions.

pelvic_len_over_SL.reason: same area multiplier, taken on the linear dimension (sqrt), so the pelvic planform scales with the rest

flight_muscle_fraction.reason: physics/flier/tff/tff.json tff.muscle.fraction = 0.16, aerobic (red) flight muscle. Above the bat mean 0.0913 (PMC10966098); no fish value exists.

caveat_morphological_not_genetic: MORPHOLOGICAL interpolation, not genetic hybridisation. Averaging two species' body parameters says nothing about whether such an animal could be bred, is viable, or is developmentally reachable; genomes do not average. Flying fish and zebrafish are not crossable. This is a shape, not an organism.
